 City boss Enzo Maresca will be expecting a response from his players after seeing his side fall from top spot to third following a concerning run of three consecutive defeats to Aston Villa, Brighton and Nottingham Forest. 
 Looking to take advantage of its opponents’ dented confidence, Fulham has made a marked improvement since its woeful start under Álvaro Arbeloa. The Cottagers earned back-to-back draws against Aston Villa and Newcastle before the break, illustrating their newfound resilience. 
 More from CNET
 Manchester City takes on Fulham on Saturday, Nov. 21, at the Etihad Stadium. Kickoff is set for  12:30 p.m. GMT . That makes it a  7:30 a.m. ET  or  4:30 a.m. PT  start in the US and Canada, and an  11:30 p.m. AEDT  kickoff in Australia.
 How to watch Man City vs. Fulham in the US without cable
 Today’s match at the Etihad will be broadcast on USA Network, which you can access on Sling TV and other, more expensive streaming TV services such as YouTube TV or DirecTV MySports.

 How to watch the Premier League 2026-27 from anywhere with a VPN
 If you’re traveling abroad and want to keep up with all the EPL action while away from home, a VPN can help enhance your privacy and security when streaming. 
 Virtual private networks encrypt your traffic and prevent your internet service provider from throttling your speeds, and can also be helpful when connecting to public Wi-Fi networks while traveling, adding an extra layer of protection for your devices and logins. VPNs are legal in many countries, including the US and Canada, and can be used for legitimate purposes such as improving online privacy and security. 
 However, some streaming services may have policies that restrict VPN use for accessing region-specific content. If you’re considering a VPN for streaming, check the platform’s terms of service to ensure compliance. 
 If you choose to use a VPN, follow the provider’s installation instructions to ensure you’re connected securely and in compliance with applicable laws and service agreements. Some streaming platforms may block access when a VPN is detected, so verifying if your streaming subscription allows VPN usage is crucial.

 Livestream Man City vs. Fulham in the UK
 This Saturday lunchtime clash is exclusive to TNT Sports in the UK and is one of 52 games the network will be showing live this season.
 The logo for UK TV broadcaster TNT Sports. / TNT Sports

 Expert Take 
 TNT Sports will be offering a sizable 52 matches exclusively live this season to viewers in the UK.
 TNT Sports transitioned over to HBO Max in the UK in March 2026. The standalone monthly pass for it currently costs £31. If you’re bundling it with other services, prices start at £25 per month on broadband networks such as BT or EE.
 Livestream Man City vs. Fulham in Canada
 If you want to stream EPL games live in Canada this season, you’ll need to subscribe to Fubo. The service has exclusive rights to the EPL once again, showing all 360 matches, including this one.

If you want to upgrade to the Sports Pro Monthly plan, which includes DAZN access, it costs $55 per month (the first month’s price is $35). 
 Livestream Man City vs. Fulham in Australia
 Australian livestreaming rights for the EPL are held by Stan Sport, which will show all 380 matches live, including this game.
